description:
Intent i018 (branch=kind-callback-tb-gaps, snapshot=s02) concluded with an evidence-backed negative over the audited per-kind callback surface; final artifact written to agent-state/findings/i018.json (version 1, execution_status=complete, snapshots_checked=["s02"], findings=[], 12 candidates, 8 limitations).

Tasked primary candidate resolved: net/netfilter/nft_tunnel.c nft_tunnel_get_init in s02 carries the CORRECTED guard at lines 80-82 ('if (!tb[NFTA_TUNNEL_KEY] || !tb[NFTA_TUNNEL_DREG]) return -EINVAL;' — '||' not '&&'), so nla_get_be32(tb[NFTA_TUNNEL_KEY]) at 84, the optional MODE use guarded at 96-102, and nft_parse_register_store(ctx, tb[NFTA_TUNNEL_DREG],...) at 104 are all covered; nft_tunnel_policy (67-71) types KEY/DREG/MODE plain NLA_U32 (non-required) but the guard proves presence of both consumed indices. This is the fixed form of the s01 instance (fact f013); the s02 tree already contains the correction.

Strongest structural candidate refuted: drivers/net/ethernet/qualcomm/rmnet/rmnet_config.c:142 — rmnet_newlink dereferences data[IFLA_RMNET_MUX_ID] with no in-function guard, but rmnet_link_ops registers .validate=rmnet_rtnl_validate which rejects 'if (!data || !data[IFLA_RMNET_MUX_ID]) return -EINVAL;' (lines 276-279), and __rtnl_newlink (net/core/rtnetlink.c) invokes ops->validate at 3330-3334 BEFORE changelink dispatch (3363-3370, gated on linkinfo[IFLA_INFO_DATA]) and newlink dispatch (3451-3452); rmnet_changelink additionally guards MUX_ID (308) and FLAGS (333) per-attribute.

Negative pattern established over the audited kinds: the dispatch core sets data=NULL when IFLA_INFO_DATA is absent (rtnetlink.c:3317-3329) and calls ops->validate first; every examined kind that unconditionally dereferences data[] inside newlink (gtp, geneve, vxlan, rmnet) carries a .validate rejecting !data, and every examined kind without .validate (ipoib, caif_hsi, chnl_net, vxcan, bond, hsr) either checks !data itself or wraps each consumed slot in a per-attribute guard. gtp_newlink's seed-shaped '&&' guard (gtp.c:668-669, !FD0 && !FD1) is the intentional at-least-one idiom with all uses individually guarded inside gtp_encap_enable (846+). geneve_nl2info (1410+) and vxlan_nl2conf (3975+) — the sole attribute consumers of their newlink/changelink — guard every consumed slot per-attribute, closing the gap left for s03 in fact f008. bond (all ~27 attributes), hsr (per-slave rejection), ipoib, caif, vxcan verified safe.

Bounded limitations: rtnl_link_ops kinds enumerated but not deep-read remain unaudited (macvlan/macvtap/ipvlan/ipvtap, wireguard, virt_wifi, bareudp, dummy, ifb, nlmon, vrf, veth, team, tun, ppp, netdevsim, batman-adv, rocker, 6lowpan, ovs-internal, ip_gre/erspan, ipip, ip_vti, ip6_gre/ip6erspan, ip6_tunnel, ip6_vti, sit, xfrm_interface, macsec, br_netlink); net/sched per-kind init/change callbacks consuming tca[TCA_OPTIONS] were not audited; nft expression init callbacks beyond nft_tunnel.c were not systematically enumerated; vlan_netlink.c QOS nested-iteration guards (lines ~119-127) left unresolved. No compilation or reproducer was run (read-only tree); all conclusions rest on exact source reading. Reachability context: RTM_NEWLINK requires CAP_NET_ADMIN over the target netns (rtnl_link_get_net_capable, rtnetlink.c:2208-2224), satisfiable from an unprivileged user namespace — same trust model as the seed.
